$comment: Single source of truth for Tidefern design tokens. Semantic colors carry a light and a dark value; the generator writes apps/web/src/app/tokens.css. Every text pairing listed in use was measured against WCAG 2.2 AA.

colors.name: page
colors.label: Page
colors.use: The page canvas. Mist in light; deep fern in dark. Pair with text or muted.

colors.name: surface
colors.label: Surface
colors.use: Cards, inputs and raised content. Pair with text or muted.

colors.name: panel
colors.label: Panel
colors.use: Grouped regions such as a day summary or settings block. Use sparingly for hierarchy.

colors.name: overlay
colors.label: Overlay
colors.use: Dialogs, menus and sheets that float above the page. The highest surface tier; pair with text or muted.

colors.name: text
colors.label: Text
colors.use: Headings, body copy and meaningful icons on page, surface and panel. Measured 11.9:1 light and 14.9:1 dark on page.

colors.name: muted
colors.label: Supporting text
colors.use: Secondary information. Passes 4.5:1 on page, surface, panel and overlay in both themes. Keep essential text fully opaque.

colors.name: accent
colors.label: Accent
colors.use: Links, selected navigation and emphasis text. A darkened sea glass in light (6.2:1 on page, 4.7:1 on warmth), a lifted sea glass in dark (8.9:1).

colors.name: action
colors.label: Action fill
colors.use: Primary button backgrounds. Always pair with action-text.

colors.name: action-text
colors.label: Action text
colors.use: Content on the action fill. Measured 8.3:1 light and 8.9:1 dark.

colors.name: border
colors.label: Control border
colors.use: Edges of inputs and controls. Meets 3:1 non-text contrast on page, surface, panel and overlay in both themes.

colors.name: soft-border
colors.label: Grouping border
colors.use: Functional separators and panel boundaries. Never the only indicator of state.

colors.name: focus
colors.label: Focus ring
colors.use: Keyboard focus outline. Two pixels, offset, on every interactive element.

colors.name: success
colors.label: Success
colors.use: Confirmed states, derived from Sage and darkened for text (5.5:1 on panel in light). Pair an icon or text; color alone never carries meaning.

colors.name: warning
colors.label: Warning
colors.use: Needs attention. Derived from clay, darkened for light text use (5.4:1).

colors.name: danger
colors.label: Danger
colors.use: Errors and destructive confirmation, including inside dialogs on the overlay tier. Passes 4.5:1 on every surface it is used on.

colors.name: data-period
colors.label: Period mark
colors.use: Logged period days on the ring and calendar. A predicted period uses the same color as a 2 px dashed stroke with no fill, so prediction never relies on color alone.

colors.name: data-fertile
colors.label: Fertile mark
colors.use: Fertile window on the ring and calendar; estimated windows are dotted. Ovulation uses the text role, today uses the action role.

colors.name: data-band
colors.label: Percentile band
colors.use: Growth chart percentile band at 40 percent fill with a 1 px solid edge in the same color; the measurement line uses the text role and ends in the frond curl.

colors.name: tide
colors.label: Tide
colors.use: Decorative water only: the tide hairline and the hero. Never text and never a data mark.

colors.name: leaf
colors.label: Leaf
colors.use: Decorative fern fills and the mark's inner leaflets only. Never text and never a data mark.

colors.name: warmth
colors.label: Warmth
colors.use: Warm surface accent such as a highlighted day. Pair with text, accent or danger; muted does not pass on it, and no form control sits on it because the control border measures under 3:1 there.

type.name: font-serif
type.use: Display, headings and the wordmark text.

type.name: type-display
type.use: Page statement. One H1 per page. Serif, weight 500, line height 1.05.

type.name: type-heading
type.use: Section headings. Serif, weight 500, line height 1.15.

type.name: type-subheading
type.use: Card and group titles. Sans, weight 600.

type.name: type-body
type.use: Reading text at desktop sizes. Mobile uses 1rem.

type.name: type-small
type.use: Navigation, controls and short labels. Never hide essential details in tiny text.

type.name: type-caption
type.use: Timestamps and captions. Minimum size in the product.

radius.name: radius-sheet
radius.use: Large containers and the app icon frame

radius.name: radius-round
radius.use: Pills, avatars and the cycle ring

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.use: A view settling into place after navigation

motion.name: duration-tide
motion.use: The slow decorative tide on the marketing page

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.use: A view settling into place after a navigation the person started

sound.name: sound-master-gain
sound.use: Master bus level. UI sound stays quiet.

sound.name: sound-hover-gain
sound.use: Peak gain of the hover tick

sound.name: sound-press-gain
sound.use: Peak gain of the press drop, the toggle and the error cue

sound.name: sound-success-gain
sound.use: Peak gain of the first success note; the second plays at 80 percent

sound.name: sound-press-hz
sound.use: Press drop start pitch; it falls a fourth over 90 ms. The toggle cue is the same interval rising.

sound.name: sound-error-end-hz
sound.use: Error cue end pitch over 180 ms

sound.name: sound-min-gap-ms
sound.use: Minimum gap between two hover ticks

sound.name: haptic-tap-ms
sound.use: Vibration on a touch press where the platform supports it

sound.name: haptic-success-pattern
sound.use: Vibration pattern on success, milliseconds on and off

weight.name: weight-serif
weight.use: Newsreader for display, headings and the wordmark

weight.name: weight-numeral
weight.use: Display numerals, Figtree with tabular figures

breakpoint.name: breakpoint-phone
breakpoint.use: Up to this width: phone layout, bottom tab bar in the app

breakpoint.name: breakpoint-tablet
breakpoint.use: Up to this width: tablet layout

breakpoint.name: breakpoint-rail
breakpoint.use: From this width: left rail in the app

size.name: size-control
size.use: Minimum control height and touch target

size.name: size-icon
size.use: Icon size in controls; icons are drawn on a 24 px grid with a 1.6 px stroke

elevation.name: elevation-shadow
elevation.use: No drop shadows anywhere. Layers separate by surface tier, a 1 px soft-border and the scrim.

elevation.name: elevation-scrim
elevation.use: Opacity of the page color behind dialogs and sheets
